mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EVENTS ( EVENT_ID, TITLE, START_DT, END_DT, PROJ_ID, ITEM_TYPE, USER_ID, EVENT_COLOR ) VALUES ( SEQ_EVENT_ID.NEXTVAL, #{projName} || ' 시작', TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{projId}, 'PROJ', #{leaderId}, '#3788d8' )
INSERT INTO PROJ_MEMBERS (PROJ_MEMBER_ID, PROJ_ID, USER_ID, PROJ_ROLE) VALUES (SEQ_PROJ_MEMBER_ID.NEXTVAL, #{projId}, #{userId}, #{role})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PROJ_MEMBERS WHERE PROJ_ID = #{projId} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT * FROM USERS WHERE USER_ID IN (SELECT USER_ID FROM WS_MEMBERS WHERE WS_ID = #{wsId}) AND USER_ID NOT IN (SELECT USER_ID FROM PROJ_MEMBERS WHERE PROJ_ID = #{projId})
SELECT m.USER_ID, u.USER_NAME, u.EMAIL, m.PROJ_ROLE FROM PROJ_MEMBERS m JOIN USERS u ON m.USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE m.PROJ_ID = #{projId}
SELECT PROJ_ID, PROJ_NAME, WS_ID FROM PROJECTS WHERE WS_ID = #{wsId} ORDER BY PROJ_ID DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) as TOTAL, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'TODO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as TODO_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as IN_PROGRESS_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as DONE_CNT FROM EVENTS WHERE PROJ_ID = #{projId} AND ITEM_TYPE = 'TASK'

SELECT EVENT_ID AS TASK_ID, TITLE, STATUS, TO_CHAR(START_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS START_DATE, TO_CHAR(END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS END_DATE FROM EVENTS WHERE PROJ_ID = #{projId} AND ITEM_TYPE = 'TASK' ORDER BY STATUS, EVENT_ID DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EVENTS ( EVENT_ID, PROJ_ID, WS_ID, USER_ID, TITLE, STATUS, ITEM_TYPE, START_DT, END_DT ) VALUES ( SEQ_EVENT_ID.NEXTVAL, #{projId}, #{wsId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{status}, 'TASK', TO_DATE(#{startDate} || ' 00:00:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), TO_DATE(#{endDate} || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') )
mapper.select: SELECT p.PROJ_ID, p.PROJ_NAME, p.PROJ_DESC, p.LEADER_ID, p.PROJ_TYPE, TO_CHAR(e.START_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS START_DATE, TO_CHAR(e.END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS END_DATE FROM PROJECTS p LEFT JOIN EVENTS e ON p.PROJ_ID = e.PROJ_ID AND e.ITEM_TYPE = 'PROJ' WHERE p.PROJ_ID = #{projId}
SELECT EVENT_ID AS "TASK_ID", TITLE, TO_CHAR(START_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "START_DATE", TO_CHAR(END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "END_DATE", STATUS FROM EVENTS WHERE EVENT_ID = #{taskId}
mapper.update: UPDATE EVENTS SET TITLE = #{title}, START_DT = TO_DATE(#{startDate} || ' 00:00:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), END_DT = TO_DATE(#{endDate} || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), STATUS = #{status} WHERE EVENT_ID = #{taskId}
UPDATE EVENTS SET START_DT = TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), END_DT = TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 WHERE PROJ_ID = #{projId} AND ITEM_TYPE = 'PROJ'
